import numpy as np
import warnings
from xarray import Dataset

warnings.simplefilter('always')
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:

    ds = Dataset().expand_dims({'time': [np.datetime64('2018-01-01', 's')]})
    probe('result_dtype_code', float(ds.time.dtype.str.endswith('8')))  # 1 if [ns] (8 bytes), 0 if [s] (8 bytes too but different unit)
    probe('result_dtype_str', ord(ds.time.dtype.str[-2]))  # Get the unit character code
    probe('warning_raised', float(len([x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, UserWarning) and 'non-nanosecond' in str(x.message)]) > 0))
    probe('dtype_ns_check', float(ds.time.dtype == np.dtype('datetime64[ns]')))

import numpy as np

from xarray.core.variable import Variable
